test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
In this question, relationship between different elements is shown in the statement. This statement is followed by two conclusions:

Statement:

T > H > U ≤ R U

ii) A < R

Choose the appropriate one from the following options

(A) Only conclusion i follows

(B) Only conclusion ii follows

(C) Either i or ii follows

(D) Neither i nor ii follows

(E) Both i and ii follow
solution:
Given statement: T > H > U ≤ R Conclusions:

Conclusion I : T > U → True (As **T** > H > **U** ≤ R U, therefore it is true)

Conclusion II : A False (As T > H > U ≤ **R** R , therefore it is false.)

Thus, **(A) Only conclusion i follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
